repair.diagnosis: The fixed sticky-promo overlays and intercepts clicks on the fixed Add to Cart button
repair.evidenceSummary: Screenshot shows the bottom promo bar with no visible Add to Cart button. Hit tests at mobile, small, and desktop report add-to-cart in viewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement sticky-promo. In styles.css add-to-cart is fixed at bottom:16px with z-index:10, while sticky-promo is fixed at bottom:0, height:84px, z-index:20, covering the button area.
repair.rationale: Moving the button to 100px from the bottom places it 16px above the 84px-high promo, preserving both elements while making the button visible and clickable.

parsed.rationale: Fix correctly addresses diagnosed overlay: add-to-cart at bottom:16px z-index:10 was covered by sticky-promo at bottom:0 height:84px z-index:20 (hitIsSelf=false, hitElement=sticky-promo). Moving to bottom:100px places button 16px above promo, preserving both elements. Evidence shows 3 interactive/pointer failures resolved (interactive-usable@mobile/small/desktop and pointer-purchase-works) with no new failures; remaining cart-total failures are pre-existing and unrelated.

repair.diagnosis: Cart total uses a stale legacy unit price instead of the catalog price for nova-sneaker
repair.evidenceSummary: Catalog priceMinor is 8900 and screenshot shows $89.00, but probes show cart totals 7900 after 1 item and 15800 after 2 items (2 x 7900), not 8900/17800 derived from the catalog
repair.rationale: Replace the stale hardcoded legacy price in the cart calculation with product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG, the single source of truth, without hardcoding the catalog value

parsed.rationale: Fix correctly replaces stale hardcoded LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) with product.priceMinor from window.CATALOG (8900), aligning cart calculation with catalog source of truth and screenshot ($89.00). Evidence shows totals now correctly 8900/17800 vs prior 7900/15800, clearing both failing signals with no hardcoded value and deterministic probe pass.
